blocks.html: En Torrevieja conviven viviendas habituales, segundas residencias y alojamientos turísticos; el método y la forma de coordinar la visita se adaptan a cada uno. El trabajo lo realiza personalmente un técnico especializado solo en chinches de cama.

blocks.html: Torrevieja has permanent homes, second homes and tourist accommodation side by side; the method and how the visit is coordinated are adapted to each. The work is done personally by a technician who specialises only in bed bugs.

Depending on the severity, the furniture and surfaces, the presence of children or pets and the use of the property, targeted chemical treatment, dry steam or a combination is chosen. See integrated pest management. If you manage tourist accommodation, see also the accommodation service.
